minimal_architecture.business_authority: One existing control process and authority DB; no second scheduler
minimal_architecture.supervisor: Stable native SCM service under dedicated restricted identity; handles release slots, health and recovery only
minimal_architecture.control_identity: Separate restricted identity launched through immutable SCM launcher; candidate never runs with supervisor token
minimal_architecture.scm_rights: Supervisor start/stop/query only on named control service; candidate cannot reconfigure/uninstall services or ACLs
minimal_architecture.malicious_control_boundary: Canary control legitimately writes business DB, so supervisor cannot trust DB acceptance/status alone. Independent presealed admission and current independent signed observation plus host-collected evidence authorize release.
minimal_architecture.source_policy: SHA-256 contents plus reviewed source/build/dependency manifest approved in protected install allowlist; optional stdlib Ed25519 detached signatures with independently enrolled keys
minimal_architecture.no_fake_signature_trust: A key shipped by candidate and its own signature are insufficient
minimal_architecture.fixture_host: Kept FIXTURE; production host provisioning is separate and requires actual OS identity proof

frozen_windows.negative_fault_injection: May be immediate; never substitutes successful observation window
frozen_windows.restarts: Do not count missing observation time as successful coverage; reconcile before action

rollback.first_live_candidate_scope: No schema change; independently proved dual-version-compatible program change
rollback.compatible_data: Return program pointer to exact last-known-good build, then real health and task continuation
rollback.incompatible_data: Only frozen, rehearsed maintenance-window data restore; unknown/lost writes or effects freeze writes and enter recovery
rollback.malicious_or_dead_candidate: Supervisor journal, process control and recovery remain usable without candidate API
rollback.unknown_effect: Preserve old key and Run/epoch, never resend because version changed
rollback.frozen_digest: Persists outside candidate-writable DB; same digest cannot bypass by renaming or restart
rollback.resource_outage: Provider rate limits/billing use ResourceRequest; no repeated version oscillation

delivery_bundle.stop_and_disable: Drain/checkpoint/reconcile/flush and wait for process exit; remove only owned service/package, preserve project data/backups/evidence
